## Historical audit: S0057

**Source:** `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_pilot/quota_restored_20261103/retired/results/r1/sceneevolve_cli/C2/test/commons_163096530/trajectory.jsonl`.

| Evidence | Observation |
|---|---|
| Student `model_request`, JSONL line 1, chars [0,9988) | The task was to reconstruct an indoor RGB scene as editable, multipart SceneAct/Blender geometry, with a matching camera, materials and lighting. The first response was to include an image specification and a complete program. These are requested goals, not evidence of an implemented scene. |
| Student `codex_session`, line 2, chars [0,2633) | One fresh, read-only CLI session was launched with an image argument. It failed with exit code 1 after about 8.4 seconds; the record reports zero tool calls and does not expose the underlying model rounds. |
| Student `model_error`, line 3, chars [0,552); `scene_error`, line 4, chars [0,1615) | The runtime raised an error because the student process exited 1. The trace points to a stderr file but does not include its contents, so the underlying cause is unknown. |

**Outcome and validation.** This is a **technical interruption**, not demonstrated algorithm failure or a successful reconstruction. No student response, program, scene change, build, render, visual comparison, or submitted output is visible. It is not evidence of an empty patch: no patch is shown. The reference image itself is not included in the observations, so its contents cannot be independently assessed.

**Scene-specific checks.** The instructions request multiple objects, materials, connected multipart assemblies, camera and lighting, but no resulting geometry or image is visible. Thus object count and identity, textures, part connections, pose, framing, illumination, and render defects cannot be verified. In particular, a rendering problem cannot be diagnosed when no render is recorded.

**Teacher and exploration.** No teacher detection, diagnosis, proposed update, execution, or student receipt and adoption of teacher input appears in this trace. No autonomous exploration or revision is visible; the failed session reports no tool events. The prompt's prescribed checks and review workflow are instructions, not checks actually performed.

**Lessons and uncertainty.** Transferably, distinguish process startup and an image argument from a completed model response, and inspect the actual error before attributing failure to scene construction. Task-specific questions—what objects were present and whether any camera or material choices would match—remain unresolved. The absent stderr contents and unexposed internal model rounds prevent a more precise failure diagnosis.
